description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface and acts as a filter that forwards only message content in a logging chain, omitting metadata such as tags and priority. It is used for simplified on-screen logging displays.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode that forwards only log messages, omitting tags, priorities, and exceptions.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor that sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Processes log entries by forwarding only the message to the next node if it exists.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
